categories.name: Bug reports
categories.definition: The observation reports a concrete failure or incorrect behavior in an existing feature or workflow. A failure may affect only one environment. A fix verification belongs here only when it explicitly reports a remaining failure. It is unrelated when a problem is mentioned only as the background to a successful fix. A missing feature, setup instructions, or a proposed change is unrelated.
examples: Remote browser capture fails with a timeout, even though local sessions work
Search returned no result for a document that it previously found

categories.name: Capability gaps
categories.definition: An observation that a needed tool, workflow, integration, or capability is absent or insufficient for the task. Exclude broken behavior in an existing capability unless the observation also describes a distinct unmet need.
examples: There is no voice cloning capability in the audio workflow
The toolkit cannot export this data with its attribution

categories.name: Resolution updates
categories.definition: A follow-up that records the observed result of investigating, correcting, working around, or fixing a previous problem. Include partial fixes and new evidence that changes the earlier account. An initial regression report belongs elsewhere, even when it compares a broken version with a working version. A plan or suggestion without an observed outcome is unrelated.
examples: Local browser capture works after the fix; remote capture still times out
The repro only applies to older browser sessions
